stemMd: A notice says a visitor may enter if and only if registered. Which situation violates this rule?

options.label: B
options.textMd: A registered visitor is refused entry.

options.label: C
options.textMd: An unregistered visitor is refused entry.

explanationMd: “If and only if” supplies both directions: entry requires registration, and registration is sufficient for permission to enter. Refusing a registered visitor contradicts the second direction. A mere “only if” statement would not have guaranteed entry to every registered visitor.

distractorRationale.e: This is exactly the permission required by the rule.
distractorRationale.c: This agrees with registration being necessary.
distractorRationale.a: This is one direction of the stated equivalence.
distractorRationale.d: This is consistent with the registration requirement.
